<SECTION-2 ACLASS="MANDATORY">
<TITLE ATOC="Y" AASSOCNOTE="D-0-1-6-0">6. 翡   </TITLE>
<P></P>
<P> ̻ȸ  ȸ Ǹ Ͽ  ǽ  , Ŀ  ̷   Ȯ   ȯ ְ Ͽ  ǽ Դϴ.</P>
<PGBRK></PGBRK>
